items.fact: Mitigation: reward ensembling, 3-4 RMs (or judge + rules), min/mean; a loophole must fool all judges

items.fact: Mitigation: length normalisation / penalties remove the length channel

items.fact: Length penalties 'also fix GRPO's length bias'

items.fact: Mitigation: reward clipping / shaping, cap per-response reward
items.where: Reading, Mitigations table with PAR principles and Table 1 chart (plain clipping collapsed in that setup)

items.fact: Mitigation: harden the verifier: hidden tests, fuzzed/mutated tests, sandbox the grader, strip grader code from context, patch known exploits continuously

items.fact: Mitigation: inoculation prompting: during training only, tell the model hacking is acceptable; breaks the link between hacking and general dishonesty; still hacks but stops generalising
items.where: Reading, Mitigations table (wording kept) and Why it matters more now (verbatim prompts)
